items.translation: 调用 `with(option, null)` 的便捷方法。

items.source: Adds the given option by name to this keyspaces's options.
items.translation: 通过名称向此键空间添加给定选项。

items.source: It is important to note that although this class depends on KeyspaceOption for convenient and typesafe use, it ultimately stores its options in a Map<String,Object> for flexibility. This means that with(KeyspaceOption) and with(KeyspaceOption, Object) delegate to with(String, Object, boolean, boolean). This design allows the API to support new Cassandra options as they are introduced without having to update the code immediately.
items.translation: 值得注意的是，虽然该类依赖 KeyspaceOption 以实现便捷且类型安全的用法，但其最终将选项存储在一个 Map<String,Object> 中以提供灵活性。这意味着 with(KeyspaceOption) 和 with(KeyspaceOption, Object) 会委托给 with(String, Object, boolean, boolean)。这种设计使得 API 能够在引入新的 Cassandra 选项时无需立即更新代码即可提供支持。

items.source: Options that have null values are considered single string options where the name of the option is the string to be used. Otherwise, the result of Object.toString() is considered to be the value of the option with the given name. The value, after conversion to string, may have embedded single quotes escaped according to parameter escape and may be single-quoted according to parameter quote.
items.translation: 具有空值的选项被视为单字符串选项，其中该选项的名称即为要使用的字符串。否则，Object.toString() 的结果被视为具有给定名称的选项的值。该值在转换为字符串后，可根据参数 escape 转义嵌入的单引号，并可根据参数 quote 被单引号包围。

items.source: Sets the given table option. This is a convenience method that calls with(String, Object, boolean, boolean) appropriately from the given KeyspaceOption and value for that option.
items.translation: 设置给定的表选项。这是一个便捷方法，会从给定的KeyspaceOption和该选项的值中适当调用with(String, Object, boolean, boolean)。

items.source: escape - Whether to escape the value via CqlStringUtils.escapeSingle(Object). Ignored if given value is an instance of a Map.
items.translation: escape - 是否通过 CqlStringUtils.escapeSingle(Object) 转义该值。如果给定值是 Map 的实例，则此参数将被忽略。

items.source: quote - Whether to quote the value via CqlStringUtils.singleQuote(Object). Ignored if given value is an instance of a Map.
items.translation: quote - 是否通过 CqlStringUtils.singleQuote(Object) 对值进行引用。如果给定值是 Map 的实例，则此参数将被忽略。

items.source: T - the subtype of the KeyspaceOptionsSpecification.
items.translation: T - KeyspaceOptionsSpecification 的子类型。

items.source: value - The value of the option. Must be type-compatible with the KeyspaceOption.
items.translation: value - 选项的值。其类型必须与KeyspaceOption兼容。

items.source: value - The value of the option. If null, the value is ignored and the option is considered to be composed of only the name, otherwise the value's Object.toString() value is used.
items.translation: value - 选项的值。如果为 null，则忽略该值并认为该选项仅由名称组成；否则，使用值的 Object.toString() 值。

items.source: Abstract builder class to support the construction of table specifications that have table options, that is, those options normally specified by WITH ... AND ....
items.translation: 抽象构建器类，用于支持具有表选项的表规范构造，即通常由 `WITH ... AND ...` 指定的那些选项。
